answering.note: five simulated-engine defects in the probe, fixed BEFORE wiring

fixed_this_claim.1_fixed_probe_name_and_unowned_rmtree: was `place/.identity-probe` plus `shutil.rmtree(..., ignore_errors=True)` -- it would delete whatever a previous attempt or anybody else had left at that name. It is `tempfile.mkdtemp` now, and `_remove_probe` pins the directory's (dev, ino) at creation and REFUSES to remove a name that has since become something else.
fixed_this_claim.2_the_global_cache: REMOVED entirely. The key named neither the port nor the place, so a second unavailable engine was answered 'supported' with zero calls. The review says removing it is acceptable, and conservative is the only safe direction for a question whose wrong answer is 'you may launch'.
fixed_this_claim.3_symlink_and_hardlink_output: `os.stat` follows a link, so a runtime that wrote one pointing at a manager-owned file outside the mount had THAT file's ownership read back as its own. `_probe_owner` opens `O_NOFOLLOW` and requires a regular file with ONE link.
fixed_this_claim.4_cleanup_and_its_failure: a client-side timeout stops waiting, not the engine. The helper is removed by name on EVERY path in a `finally`, a reclamation that fails makes the observation unmeasured rather than being swallowed, and an unremovable probe directory is refused rather than ignored.
fixed_this_claim.5_the_remapped_fixture: patching `stat` inside the producer proved nothing about a remapped OBSERVATION. The fixture replaces what the host reports for the produced file -- the read boundary -- and is labelled SIMULATED.
fixed_this_claim.6_the_fixture_root: my new class hard-coded /var/tmp, which is read-only on the reviewer's host and cost 13 fixture errors. It honours BATON_V12_STACK_TEST_ROOT and otherwise uses the interpreter's own default; verified both ways.

STILL_NOT_WIRED.why: every deployment fixture stands the engine in with an ad-hoc object that answers a status for any argv and creates no file, so the probe correctly reports unmeasured and preflight correctly refuses -- roughly a hundred cases fail for a fixture reason. Teaching those stand-ins to model the probe is the next task; weakening the guard to fit them is the one thing this correction exists to avoid.
